name: r2 W1.0 A12 P1.5 G1.0
purpose: Board r2 (AirTag.kicad_pcb of 2026-11-14 14:30: 24 x 20 mm, F.Cu GND pour only, AE1 at (146, 97), feed routed from L1). With the feed at x 146 a straight arm ends at A 13 (L 18.4 mm, about 21.5 needed), so the end meanders. Keep-out 24 x 5 (x 138..162, the generic MIFA_2G4 one, u0 -8). S11 minimum tuned to 2.460 GHz (2.442 + 0.73 % mask shift measured on T1). Variant: 1 mm traces (best on the 24 mm board), one fold down, link, up.
